summary.claim_boundary: Development evidence only. This is not a stable pass-rate estimate.

runs.failure: A channel-scoped answer described campaign-wide shared cost as if it were attributable to the WeChat Game channel. The then-current automated gates did not detect this semantic attribution error.
runs.disposition: Cost queries now preserve channel provenance; channel slices expose a shared_costs_unallocated boundary, suppress channel efficiency, and require an explicit attribution statement in the trace evaluator.

runs.scenario: 腾讯游戏 · 回流任务季，从全渠道修订为微信游戏渠道（公开机制原型，数据完全合成）
runs.result: Passed all gates. The answer invalidated the prior all-channel conclusion, recalculated the selected channel, distinguished shared campaign cost from attributable channel cost, suppressed unsupported channel efficiency, and retained measurable continuation and stop conditions.
